up: Retrieve the compound (molecule) records that are described in the document CHEMBL5727578, showing each compound's ChEMBL identifier (chembl_id), any associated SMILES (canonical_smiles), and the primary compound name (pref_name) as reported in the document. No filtering beyond matching the specified document CHEMBL5727578 in the docs table; no target, activity, assay, or other entity constraints are required. Output all matching compounds, even if the document lists multiple compound keys or records. The result set should include the unique compound identifiers (chembl_id) and their corresponding canonical SMILES and preferred names as stored in the molecule_dictionary and compound_structures tables. The user did not request any specific ranking, limits, or additional columns beyond the basic compound identifiers and structural information.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.pref_name
FROM compound_records cr
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727578'
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
